title: Same Page update diagnostics
heading: Get the update working
intro: Did the update fail, or is the app stuck restoring your Drive? Check here without signing in again.
retryUpdate: Retry the update and record the result
retryHint: Checking and retrying keep your scores and local drafts. Retrying prepares the update without forcing other Same Page windows to reload.
feedbackHint: Send the results to the Same Page team to help identify the problem.
diagnosticScope: The check reads version information, app cache usage, and whether the local database responds. It does not read your scores, notes, filenames, or sign-in credentials, or clear local data.
retention: Sending shares the diagnostics above with the Same Page team. They are kept for up to 180 days.
release-too-large: The new version exceeds the size limit for a release. Please send a diagnostic report.
capacity-protected: The cache for an earlier version is still protected, so the app storage limit blocked this update.
quota-exceeded: The browser declined a write to storage. The report includes the estimated space usage.
integrity-mismatch: The update failed its integrity check.
download-failed: The update could not be downloaded.
storage-failed: The app cache could not be accessed.
unknown: The update could not be installed and no details are available.
databaseTimeout: The local database did not respond in time. Please send a diagnostic report.
cacheTimeout: The app cache did not respond in time. Please send a diagnostic report.
updateReady: The new version is ready. Close all Same Page windows, then reopen the app.
registrationMissing: No app update service was found on this device. Reconnect to the internet, reopen Same Page, and try again.
checkComplete: The check is complete. The cause is still unclear. You can retry the update or send a diagnostic report if it still fails.
cannotRetry: No update is available to retry. Check again first.
retrying: Retrying the update. This may take a few minutes. When it finishes, you can check again and send a report.
copyManually: Select the diagnostics above and copy them manually.
reportReceived: Thanks, we received your report. Report ID: {id}
legacyReportReceived: Thanks, we received your report. Report ID: {id}. The older service keeps your report for 30 days. Copy the extended diagnostics separately.
receiptUnconfirmed: Receipt is unconfirmed. Please resend or copy the diagnostics.
